title: Reject Announce rx_channel values outside CCP-9 range
description: P2 exact-input/security consistency: python/src/lichen/announce/messages.py accepts rx_channel 0..15 in construction and parsing, while spec/05-routing.md 9.2, AnnounceSchedulerConfig, and the canonical CCP-9 profile require 0..7. A signed or relayed channel 8..15 can enter Node peer rendezvous state and select a channel the supported radio plan does not advertise. Restrict the wire/model boundary to 0..7, add construction/parser/vector regressions, and keep spec/vector oracle exact.
